Product variants Default Title - $118.99 Quantity Decrease quantity for Animals Pedal Surfing Bear Overdrive Increase quantity for Animals Pedal Surfing Bear Overdrive Add to cart     #OVERDRIVE , #PEDAL , Couldn't load pickup availability Refresh Share Share Link Close share Copy link Our Surfing Bear Overdrive is an overdrive pedal to help create one of those most signature guitar sounds in all of music from a clean boost to light crunch and warm drive sounds that can easily be played for both rhythm and lead. With our latest edition of the SBO, we have placed the footswitch closer to the front right side as well as making it easier to replace the 9v battery. And we have a beautiful design and artwork by noted surf art painter Jonas Cleasson from Australia. A bear that has breakfast coffee while surfing brings a heartwarming touch and sense of mono no aware. The VOL knob has a high output level if needed to boost, and if you keep the DRIVE knob low can be used as a clean booster. Adjust the TONE knob to accentuate treble frequencies and make it a treble booster pedal. Turn up the DRIVE knob to hear an overdrive with sustainability, clear attack, and low noise. The SBO may be based upon the classic “808” style platform, but the circuit has been upgraded and expanded to be a much more modern take on this classic overdrive platform. Guitarists today require a wide dynamic range, responsiveness, and clarity with an overdrive pedal and the Surfing Bear brings it with grace and ease. Bring your sound forward without being abrasive – get some overdrive gain from the Surfing Bear Overdrive and feel the power of a truly full-spectrum screaming overdrive experience! ●Control VOL: Adjusts the overall volume. DRIVE: Adjusts the strength of the distortion. TONE: Adjusts the tone balance centered on the high frequencies. Surfing Bear Overdrive adopts true bypass switching and is powered by a 9V battery or a standard center minus DC9V adapter. ●Specifications Current consumption: 15mA Input impedance: 500k ohm Output impedance: 10k ohm Size: 64 W x 112 D x 50 H mm (including projections) Weight: 382g INFORMATION Search Product About US Shipping Policy Contact Twitter Instagram YouTube Payment methods American Express Apple Pay Google Pay JCB Mastercard PayPal Shop Pay Visa © 2026, Animals Pedal USA Choosing a selection results in a full page refresh.
